about: Caltrain (San Francisco Peninsula commuter rail): real-time departures per station, GTFS-realtime trip updates and vehicle positions, service alerts, routes, station pages and site search as JSON commands.

commands.summary: Real-time departure predictions for one Caltrain station, with metadata for the routes serving it (Local, Limited, Express, South County).

params.name: stopId
params.description: Station stop id in lowercase snake_case, e.g. san_francisco, palo_alto, sj_diridon. This is not the same as the station page slug.

commands.summary: Current Caltrain service alerts: delays, disruptions and notices, with their active periods.
GTFS-realtime trip updates for trains currently running: trip id, route, direction and predicted arrival/departure per stop.
All Caltrain routes/service types (Local Weekday, Limited, Express, South County…) with route id, color and path.
Station detail page (address, parking, amenities, zone) by station slug.

params.name: slug
params.description: Station page slug with no separators, e.g. paloalto, sanfrancisco, sjdiridon
